content:
sam: hi all, onboarding day 2. trying to get cloud access sorted. need AWS SSO access to assume the 'Redwood-Dedicated' role and GCP billing + project access for redwood-private-us and redwood-prod-billing. who handles billing account perms? also curious about region quotas in us-west-2 — we run inference there.

toni: welcome! For AWS we use AWS SSO permission sets. Ask @infra to attach the 'DedicatedAccess' permission set to your SSO user. No raw IAM user creation.

toni: For GCP billing, Finance owns the billing account role. They give Billing Account Viewer or Billing Account User depending on what you need. Finance prefers a ticket with business justification.

sam: thanks — is there a template for the billing ticket? and do I need BigQuery or service account roles too for deployments?

finance-bot: Please submit a billing access request at https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/BillingRequest using the "Billing Access" template. Required fields: requester email, team, reason, projects to be added, and requested role (Viewer/User).

infra: @sam pinged — I can handle AWS SSO. Which AWS account ID do you need? If it's Dedicated, it's account 123456789012. We'll map the SSO group 'dedicated-engineering' and add you to it. Also note: we require 2FA + yubikey enrollment before granting SSO group membership.

sam: got it. submitting billing ticket now. for GCP, i definitely need project-level access to redwood-private-us and viewer on redwood-prod-billing. any special SA to request?

cloud-sre: For deployments we usually bind 'roles/iam.serviceAccountUser' to the user for the service account platform-deploy@redwood-private.iam.gserviceaccount.com and 'roles/viewer' on billing project. If you need quota increases (GPUs/CPUs in us-west-2), open a quota request in Cloud Console and cc @cloud-sre.

toni: sample commands infra runs (you won't run these unless infra asks you to):
```bash
# AWS SSO: nothing to run as user, infra attaches permission set to your SSO subject
# GCP grant (infra will run):
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-private-us \
  --member='user:sam@redwood.com' --role='roles/iam.serviceAccountUser'

gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod-billing \
  --member='user:sam@redwood.com' --role='roles/viewer'
```

sam: perfect. FYI i'll request Billing Account Viewer first so I can at least see invoices. will tag infra and cloud-sre on the quota request if needed. thanks! :smile:

infra: created INF-501: "SSO + GCP bindings for sam". ETA same day if yubikey is enrolled.

sam: yubikey enrollment is done. marking ticket with the jira link. appreciate the help everyone.
